title: How to Change Your BVN Phone Number After Losing a SIM
excerpt: Lost the SIM linked to your BVN? Learn when a SIM replacement is enough, how a BVN phone update works, and the documents to prepare.
keywords: how to change BVN phone number
I lost my BVN SIM card

sections.content: If you lost the SIM linked to your BVN, first decide whether you need a SIM replacement or an actual BVN phone-number change. If the number still belongs to you and your network can replace the SIM, keeping the same number is usually simpler. Change the BVN-linked number only when you cannot recover the old line or you have a legitimate reason to use a different one.

The phone update must pass identity checks because the linked line can be used for BVN retrieval and account verification. CBN announced in 2026 that a BVN-linked phone number may be changed only once, so do not treat the update as temporary. Confirm the current rule with your bank before submitting.

sections.content: Banks can use different checklists. Prepare your BVN, NIN or another accepted ID, the new phone number, and evidence of ownership. If the old line was lost or stolen, the institution may ask for a police report, SIM-swap evidence, or an affidavit. The names and date of birth on your supporting records should agree with the BVN profile.
How to Change the Phone Number Linked to Your BVN

steps.title: Ask whether the old SIM can be recovered
steps.content: Contact the mobile network first. A same-number replacement avoids using the limited BVN phone-change process.

steps.title: Confirm the central record
steps.content: Ask your bank which phone number is attached to the BVN and whether the mismatch is central or only in its local account profile.

steps.title: Collect current evidence
steps.content: Bring the accepted ID and proof requested for the old and new lines. Do not submit altered SIM documents or someone else's number.

steps.title: Submit and complete verification
steps.content: Use the bank's documented process or a traceable assisted channel. The institution may require in-person, biometric, or additional verification.

steps.title: Test only after confirmation
steps.content: Once approved, ask the bank to verify the new central detail. Do not repeatedly dial retrieval codes while the request is still pending.

sections.content: Can You Change a BVN Phone Number Online?

Some institutions may let you start or track a request digitally, but the central update still goes through a licensed financial institution and strong identity verification. There is no safe public form that should accept a BVN and instantly rewrite the database. Ufriends provides an assisted BVN modification route; confirm its current document and verification requirements before paying.
What to Check After the Phone Change

items: Ask your bank to confirm the new BVN-linked phone number.
Update contact details in each bank's local profile when necessary.
Test BVN retrieval only from the new registered line after completion.
Review alerts and security settings on accounts that used the lost SIM.
Block or recover the lost line with the mobile network to reduce impersonation risk.
Never give an OTP, banking PIN, or password to a person claiming to speed up the change.

sections.content: Questions About Changing a BVN Phone Number

items: Can I use any new SIM? Use a number you control and can keep long term. The institution may request evidence that the line belongs to you.
Will changing my bank alert number change the BVN number? Not necessarily. A bank's local alert contact and the phone number held on the central BVN record can be separate fields.
Can I retrieve my BVN from the new number immediately? Wait until the institution confirms that the central change is complete, then test the official retrieval route.
What if the old SIM was stolen? Block or recover it with the mobile network immediately. Also review banking-app sessions, transaction alerts, and account security controls.
Can someone update the number for a relative? The BVN holder should complete the identity verification. Assistance does not replace the holder's consent or the institution's security checks.
